facts.fact: The directive says low-value cross-border electronic funds transfers within the Common Monetary Area are currently executed through SADC-RTGS.
Eswatini payment service providers route low-value CMA cross-border transfers through the SADC-RTGS system and must move them to the TCIB scheme by 31 March 2027.

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Eswatini issued the CMA EFT Payments Directive no 1 of 2025 under the National Payments System Act, 2023, binding all payment service providers from 31 March 2025.
The directive defines payment service providers as persons or institutions licensed under section 22 of the National Payments System Act, 2023.
The directive sets a regulator deadline of 31 March 2027 for payment service providers to migrate low-value CMA cross-border transfers from SADC-RTGS to the TCIB scheme.
